QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] Maynard's Lesson: Harvesting is Crystal Clear
QuestInfo.0: There's no better way to learn than by doing!\r\nBecome a true prospector of Eluna with a private lesson from #p9400461#.
QuestInfo.1:
#eHarvesting Eluna's plant life is the easiest and safest way#n to obtain the Elunite Crystals!
Obtaining crystals from 'plants' may seem weird, but whatever gets the job done.
#eHarvest 10 of Eluna's plants.#n
QuestInfo.2: The #eeasiest and safest#n way to obtain Elunite Crystals turned out to be #eharvesting Eluna's plants#n. You should harvest any plants you encounter during your time on Eluna.

default.0: You can find all manner of plants from the moment you step outside Prospector's Township. Keep your eyes peeled, they may not look like the sort of plants you're used to.
